worlds.provenance: Enumerate independent setup choices: a D auxiliary ticket present or absent, a clean or obstructed H fixture, and a received or missing H report channel. This record uses ticket absent, clean, received. D reads its own auxiliary ticket inbox at the third half-slot; its controller clock supplies the other five symbols, including the retry tick regardless of inbox contents. The ticket is an optional auxiliary attempt outside both protected D windows, and neither its arrival nor its retry uses H evidence.
